business.description: The company is engaged in manufacturing, processing, extracting, refining, producing, blending, and dealing in all kinds of oils including edible oil, vegetable oil, hydrogenated oil, refined, bleached and/or de-odorised oils, and allied products. It also carries on the business of seeds crushing for extraction of oil from oil seeds, running oil mills and plants/refinery, and dealing in a wide range of food products, spices, agricultural produce, commodities, meat, fish, poultry, dairy products, and beverages.

outlook.statement: The proposed change in the Object Clause will enable the Company to pursue new business opportunities, diversify its operations, improve long-term growth prospects, and strengthen its competitive position.

The Company's operations and expansion plans require substantial financial resources on an ongoing basis. The Board has proposed to enhance the borrowing limits up to ₹ 5,000 crores to meet all current and anticipated funding requirements.

Considering the Company's long-term plans, potential investment opportunities, and possible financial support to group entities or strategic ventures, the Board considers it prudent to seek members' approval to authorise aggregate loans/guarantees/security/investments up to ₹ 5,000 crores.
The new management which was appointed on December 03, 2025 as per the resolution plan dated November 18, 2025, endeavours to comply with the said rule hereafter.

For FY 2026-27, the industry is expected to benefit from continued domestic demand, improved supply chain efficiencies, increasing organized trade, digital transformation across agricultural markets, and growing investments in warehousing and logistics infrastructure. However, businesses must remain vigilant against volatility arising from global commodity prices, climatic uncertainties, geopolitical events, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
During the year under review, only the necessary compliances and general updates have been undertaken by company based on the records made available.
The Company is in the process of reviving its business operations pursuant to the approved Resolution Plan.
The management believes that the Company will be able to continue its operations and meet its obligations as they fall due in the foreseeable future.
